steps.why: assemble the files the legacy code expects
run the unmodified legacy code with no network
compare the translation with legacy on every row
feed a failure back for one repair

data.rationale: We must verify that the Python implementation reproduces the legacy behavior exactly, so we run a full parity precheck and certify once it passes. Fuzzing is added to surface edge cases that may not appear in the standard test set, ensuring robustness.
